description: This PHP source file generates a web page for managing and viewing CallP/QoS statistics, logs, and configurations for a network device, including toggling logging features and displaying real-time data.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Handles toggling logging options and clearing logs by sending AJAX requests to server-side scripts.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX POST request to update QoS configuration settings and reloads the page upon success.
